segments.text: Laſtly there happeneth vnto the wordes of Chriſt leſſe than is pronounced by them in the partes of the Sacrament, ſince they affirme the bread to be the bodie alone, and the wine to be the bloud alone.

Theſe be the principall and chiefe poyntes which are contained in my booke of confeſſion againſt Gardiner, as farre as concerne the Arguments and confirmations of our part. And now this remaineth, that I lay before the courteous reader ſome ſayinges, as it were certaine ſentences, out of the which not onelie all our Argumentes in a manner are drawen, but whereby alſo the reaſons of our aduerſaries may eaſilie be confuted. And ſo all this diſputation will become both plaine and eaſie.
